home.empty: Nothing has been published on this page yet. Whoever runs the site writes it from the back office.

search.title: Search
search.label: What are you looking for?
search.empty: Type something to search the site.
search.termsTooShort: Words shorter than three letters are not indexed, so this search cannot find anything. Try a longer word.

palette.placeholder: Search, or jump to a screen

loginError.title: The sign in did not complete

reason.portal: IVAO refused the sign in. This usually means the consent was declined, or the application is not enabled for your account.
reason.correlation: The round trip could not be matched to this browser. It usually happens when the page was left open too long, or cookies were cleared halfway through.
reason.nonce: The answer from IVAO could not be validated. Try again; if it keeps happening, it is a problem on our side.
reason.profile: IVAO did not tell us who you are, so no account could be opened.
reason.unknown: Something went wrong on the way back from IVAO.

footer.disclaimer: {{division}} is a division of IVAO, a non-commercial flight simulation network. Nothing published here is intended for real world aviation.

suggest.empty: Nothing on the site matches. What you write is used as it is.
suggest.emptyClosed: Nothing here matches. A menu entry leads to a page of this site, to one of its screens, or to a link of the library.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.description: Everything this department creates will show up in this list.

edit.refused: That change was not saved. The row may have been changed by somebody else in the meantime.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.description: The address may be out of date, or the page may have been removed.

forbidden.title: This is not for you
forbidden.description: You are signed in, but your staff positions do not open this page. If you think they should, talk to your director.

links.title: Links
links.description: The addresses this department publishes on the division site.

delete.title: Delete this link?
delete.description: It disappears from the site straight away, and this cannot be undone.

menu.title: Menu
menu.description: The navigation of the division site: what it lists, and in what order.

delete.title: Delete this entry?
delete.description: It leaves the site straight away. The page it points at is untouched.

hints.path: A page of this site, one of its screens, or a link of the library. An address that is not one of these is added to the links first, so that every outside address lives in one place.
hints.parentId: Leave empty for a top level entry. A menu goes one level deep and no further.

dashboard.title: {{department}}
dashboard.description: The home of this department, and its own to arrange.
dashboard.missing: This department has no dashboard yet. One is created on the next start of the application, from the system template.

media.title: Media library
media.description: Files uploaded once and used anywhere

delete.title: Delete this file?
delete.description: The file is removed. Nothing on the site is showing it.
delete.inUse_one: One published page is showing this file, so the file itself is kept and only leaves the library.
delete.inUse_other: {{count}} published pages are showing this file, so the file itself is kept and only leaves the library.

picker.label: Files of this department
picker.emptyHint: Upload one in the media library of this department first.

hints.alt: What somebody who cannot see the picture is told instead. Every block that shows this file inherits it.

uiKit.title: Component gallery
uiKit.description: Every custom component of the hub and every block of the registry, with example props.

sample.heroLead: One sentence that says what this page is for.

sample.problem: Somebody else changed this in the meantime.
sample.noticeError: This page could not be published.
sample.noticeWarning: Two sections are not in the template any more.
sample.noticeInfo: A draft is only visible to the staff.

registry.title: Registries
registry.description: What the server declares, against what this build of the front end registered. The two halves of a module are compiled separately, so they can disagree.
registry.agree: The two sides agree: {{blocks}} block(s) and {{widgets}} tile(s).
registry.blockMissingHere: The server declares the block "{{type}}" and this build cannot draw it. The front end was probably not rebuilt with the module.
registry.blockMissingOnServer: This build registers the block "{{type}}" and the server does not know it. A page using it would be refused on save.
registry.blockVersion: The block {{detail}} is known to both sides at different versions.
registry.widgetMissingHere: The server declares the dashboard tile "{{key}}" and this build cannot draw it.
registry.widgetMissingOnServer: This build registers the dashboard tile "{{key}}" and the server does not declare it, so nothing will ask for it.

content.title: Pages
content.description: What this department publishes on the division site.
content.templateRefused: That page could not be created. Check the address is free and spelled with lower case letters, digits and dashes.

delete.title: Delete this page?
delete.description: It disappears from the site straight away, together with everything ever published of it, and this cannot be undone.

fields.title: Name
fields.locked: Pages may not change its structure

hints.key: How a page made from this template is matched back to this section. Written once: changing it later would quietly detach every page already made from this template.
hints.locked: A page can still edit the properties of the blocks that are here — it cannot add, move or remove any.

section.keyIs: Key: {{key}} — written once, so that the pages made from this template keep matching this section.

editor.structure: What this page is made of
editor.nothingSelected: Pick a section or a block to edit it.
editor.noSections: This page has no sections yet.
editor.lockedSection: The template fixes this section. Its blocks can still be edited, one at a time.
editor.saveBeforePublishing: Save the draft before publishing: what goes public is what is stored, not what is on screen.
editor.publishRefused: This page cannot be published yet

renderModes.live: The answer of the moment it is read
renderModes.frozen: What it said when the page was published

editor.renderModeHint: A captured block stops changing until somebody publishes the page again.

template.differences: The template of this page has moved on
template.publicUnchanged: Nothing has changed for a visitor: a template never rewrites a page by itself, and the public keeps reading the published version until somebody publishes this one again.
template.added: “{{section}}” was added to the template and is not on this page.
template.removed: “{{section}}” is no longer in the template.
template.changed: “{{section}}” no longer matches what the template asks for.

reasons.blocks: It holds blocks the template does not allow here.
reasons.structure: The template fixes this section, and this copy is not the same one any more.

template.lockedBy: This section is fixed by the template “{{template}}”.
template.lockedByUnknown: This section is fixed by the template this page was made from.
template.lockedYouMay: You may change it on the templates of {{department}}.
template.lockedWhoMay: Only somebody holding {{permission}} on {{department}} can change it.

editor.published: Published. The site is showing this version now.
editor.publishMissing: What is missing before this can be published

hints.seo: What a search engine shows, and what appears when somebody shares the page. Left empty, the title and the summary of the page are used.
hints.slug: The last part of the address this page is read at. Proposed from the title until you write one yourself; it does not move again once the page has been saved.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: The shapes a page, a news item or a document is made from in this department. Changing one does not change the rows already made from it: they keep what they were given until somebody republishes.
templates.madeFromIt_one: {{count}} row was made from this template.
templates.madeFromIt_other: {{count}} rows were made from this template.
templates.madeFromIt_zero: Nothing has been made from this template yet.

blocks.unknown: This page uses a block of type "{{type}}" that this browser cannot draw. It is probably a module that is not installed.
blocks.willBeCaptured: Live now, captured when you publish

hints.alt: What the picture says, for somebody who cannot see it. Leave it empty when the picture is decoration.

video.notAllowed: This address is not on a site the hub can play a video from.

fields.mediaId: Or a file of the library
fields.caption: Caption

hints.url: The address of the page the video is on.

embed.notAllowed: This address is not on a site the hub can embed.

hints.items.name: Read in place of the logo by somebody who cannot see it.

hints.tabs.body: Text with formatting. A tab holds text, never other blocks.

networkStats.label: Live on the network
networkStats.unavailable: The network cannot be reached right now.

view.agenda: A list of what is next

staffList.label: Staff
staffList.rosterNote: Only members who have signed in to this hub at least once appear here.

widgets.unknown: This installation declares a dashboard tile this browser cannot draw: {{keys}}. It is probably a module the front end was not rebuilt for.

grants.title: Permissions
grants.description: Permissions given to a single member by name, on top of what their staff positions already give them.
grants.formHint: A permission scoped to no department is held on every one of them. A deny always wins over a grant.

delete.title: Delete this permission?
delete.description: The member loses it on their very next request, and this cannot be undone.

hints.expiresAt: Empty means the grant never expires.

superadmins.title: Super administrators
superadmins.description: They bypass every policy. Only a super administrator sees this list or changes it, and the last one cannot be removed.

remove.title: Remove this super administrator?
remove.description: VID {{vid}} loses the bypass on their very next request.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: What this build was compiled with, and whether each one is accepting changes.
modules.closedHint: Reads still work; nothing can be changed.

empty.title: No module
empty.description: This build was compiled without any module.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every write on a row the hub records, written by the save changes interceptor and by nothing else.

news.title: News
news.description: What this department announces on the division site.

public.title: News
public.description: What the division has announced, most recent first.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: What this department publishes to be kept rather than read once.

public.title: Documents
public.description: Rules, guides and forms, filed by the department that keeps them.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The shelves this department files its news and documents under.

delete.title: Delete this category?
delete.description: The news and documents filed under it keep the key they were filed with, and stay where they are.

hints.key: The stable name a news item or a document is filed under. It is never shown to a visitor, and changing it leaves whatever was already filed under the old one where it is.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: What this department has coming up, and what its modules put there.
calendar.projectedExplained: This entry mirrors a row the {{module}} module owns, so it cannot be edited here: a change would be undone the next time that module saves. Change it where it comes from.

delete.title: Delete this entry?
delete.description: It disappears from the calendar straight away, and this cannot be undone.

hints.kind: One of the words the division uses, the same for every department. An entry a module brings arrives with a word of its own.
hints.url: Where the entry leads, if anywhere. A meeting link, a page of the site.

public.title: Calendar
public.description: Everything the division has coming up, in UTC and in its own time.
public.empty: Nothing in this stretch of the calendar.

contacts.title: Contact messages
contacts.description: What members have written to this department.

public.title: Write to us
public.description: Pick the department your message is about. You are signed in, so we know who you are and can answer.

sent.title: Your message is on its way
sent.description: The department has it. An answer comes back the way that department usually answers.

contact.received.title: Messages to my department
contact.received.description: An email when a member writes to a department you are staff of.

calendarKinds.title: Calendar kinds
calendarKinds.description: The words the whole division files its calendar under.
calendarKinds.formHint: These words are the same for every department: a coordinator picks one, nobody invents one. Retiring a kind leaves the entries already written with it alone.

delete.title: Delete this kind?
delete.description: The entries already filed under it keep the key they were written with, and nothing rewrites them. To stop anybody filing new ones under it, take "in use" off instead.
